issue.title: [A+] Unit tests: useRecordingEngine hook
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Test safety net**. `useRecordingEngine` lacks dedicated unit tests despite being on the record path.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Lower-level recording engine/sync tested; hook wiring untested.

**Expected:** Colocated unit tests for `useRecordingEngine` lifecycle (start/stop/error) with mocks.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Unit tests only for the hook module
- Jest + repo Expo mocks

**Out of scope**
- `useVerseAudio` (sibling)
- Full device recording QA

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Colocated tests cover start/stop/error (or equivalent public API)
- [ ] No flake in CI
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm test -- --ci -- useRecordingEngine`
2. Full CI gates

## Links

- Sibling: useVerseAudio tests ticket
